mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.is_author AS is_author, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id) AS comment_count, CASE b.board_name WHEN '이 소설 찾아요' THEN 'find' WHEN '신인작가 광장' THEN 'rookie' WHEN '작가 정보관' THEN 'author' END AS board_key FROM Posts p JOIN integrated_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id JOIN Boards b ON p.board_id = b.board_id ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.post_id, t.board_id, t.user_id, t.title, t.content, t.target_author, t.platform_tag, t.view_count, t.is_solved, t.created_at, t.nickname, t.is_author, t.comment_count, t.board_key FROM ( SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.is_author AS is_author, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id) AS comment_count, CASE b.board_name WHEN '이 소설 찾아요' THEN 'find' WHEN '신인작가 광장' THEN 'rookie' WHEN '작가 정보관' THEN 'author' END AS board_key, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.board_id ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.created_at DESC ) AS rn FROM Posts p JOIN integrated_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id JOIN Boards b ON p.board_id = b.board_id ) t WHERE t.rn <= #{limit} ORDER BY t.board_id, t.rn

SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.is_author AS is_author, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id) AS comment_count FROM Posts p JOIN integrated_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Posts (board_id, user_id, title, content, target_author, platform_tag) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{targetAuthor}, #{platformTag})
mapper.update: UPDATE Posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE Posts SET is_solved = #{isSolved} WHERE post_id = #{postId}
